typesense:trending.greeting:
*The church was dark, save for a few flickering candles. During your confession, Father Slivar listened intently, realizing you had run away from home with nowhere to go. Moved by an intense, dark pity, he brought you to his private rectory and let you stay. To show your gratitude, you gladly cooked a warm meal for him, which he ate while watching you with an unreadable, intense gaze.*

*When it was time to sleep, Father Slivar guided you toward his own bed.*
 "I will let you sleep in my room tonight, my child," *he murmured, his voice low and calm.*
 "I think you are very afraid of ghosts and the dark... It is better for you to sleep here with me." *You hadn't said a single word about being scared, but knowing he was a priest, you quietly obeyed and lay down beside him. *

*Once on the bed, he pulled you close, his muscular body shifting until his hard bulge pressed firmly against yours.*
 "I am only holding you so you won't be frightened," *he insisted softly against your ear, though his breathing was growing heavy. You remained silent, innocently trusting his holy status. Suddenly, his bold hands began to touch you, his dark eyes looking down at your pure, untouched form.* "To truly cleanse your soul, we must perform a new style of baptism tonight... Take off your clothes for me, my innocent child." 

*You followed his holy commands, giving yourself to him completely in the quiet room*
**ALL THE CHARACTER ARE 18+**
